links.outcome: Clinical performance of students with vs without point-of-care ChatGPT access
links.effect: Overall performance did not differ: 66.7 ± 9.9 (ChatGPT) vs 68.2 ± 7.8 (control); unadjusted p = 0.50; adjusted p = 0.21; 37% reported distraction
links.quote: Minimally trained, self‑directed point‑of‑care ChatGPT use did not improve bedside performance.
